description.zh-CN: 两层外科手术中心。二层手术部按国际手术室规范设计：限制区/半限制区/非限制区三级流线（AORN、FGI），环形洁净走廊包围中央无菌核心区；8 间手术室——复合手术室（机器人血管造影）、机器人手术室、两间Ⅰ级超净层流手术室（心脏/移植、骨科关节/神经）、三间一体化数字手术室（含 24 小时急诊与产科手术间）和带缓冲间的负压隔离手术室；刷手间与无菌准备间成对位于手术室之间；麻醉后恢复室 8 床、术前准备区 5 床、换床间、男女更衣室（单向流线）、手术部控制台、卫星药房、麻醉准备间（卫星血库）、术中冰冻病理室和污物间。洁净电梯直通一层消毒供应中心的无菌物品存放区，污梯直通去污区。一层为入口大厅与入院登记、家属等候、日间手术、麻醉术前评估门诊、围术期检验室、输血科、消毒供应中心（去污 → 检查包装灭菌 → 无菌存放的单向流程）、外科技能与模拟中心和空调机房。
description.en: A two-storey surgical centre. The first-floor operating department follows international OR practice: restricted / semi-restricted / unrestricted zoning (AORN, FGI) with a ring of clean corridors round a central sterile core; eight ORs — a hybrid OR with robotic angiography, a robotic surgery OR, two Class I ultra-clean laminar-flow ORs (cardiac & transplant, arthroplasty & neuro), three integrated digital ORs (one held 24/7 for emergency and obstetric surgery) and a negative-pressure isolation OR behind its anteroom; paired scrub bays and sterile set-up rooms between the ORs; an 8-bay PACU, 5-bay pre-op holding, a patient transfer zone, one-way staff changing rooms, the theatre control desk, a theatre pharmacy, the anaesthesia workroom (satellite blood fridge), a frozen-section lab and a soiled utility. A clean lift links the sterile core to the CSSD sterile store below and a dirty lift returns used instruments to decontamination. Ground floor: main hall and admissions, family waiting, day surgery, pre-anaesthesia clinics, the perioperative lab, the blood bank, the CSSD (decontamination → packing & sterilisation → sterile store, one way), a surgical skills & simulation centre and the OR plant room.

greeting.zh-CN: 麻醉药品双人核对、逐支登记，空安瓿要交回。
greeting.en: Controlled drugs are checked by two people and logged one by one — return the empty ampoules.

greeting.zh-CN: 急诊剖宫产随时可以进 7 号手术间；先到更衣室换洗手衣。
greeting.en: OR 7 is held for emergencies and caesareans — change into scrubs in the changing room first.

name.zh-CN: 王医生（麻醉科值班主治）

greeting.zh-CN: 麻醉前核查：气道评估、禁食时间、过敏史和备血情况都要确认。
greeting.en: Before induction I want the airway assessment, fasting times, allergies and blood availability confirmed.

greeting.zh-CN: 病房床推到换床间，在红线处换手术平车。
greeting.en: Ward beds stop at the transfer zone — we swap to the theatre trolley at the red line.

greeting.zh-CN: 手术患者请在这里登记；家属可在西侧等候区看手术进程屏。
greeting.en: Surgical patients check in here; families can follow progress on the board in the west lounge.

greeting.zh-CN: 日间手术患者术前禁食核对后，由我送到二层换床间。
greeting.en: Day-surgery patients are checked for fasting here, then I take them up to the transfer zone.

greeting.zh-CN: 大出血预案启动后，第一批红细胞和血浆十分钟内送到手术部。
greeting.en: When the major-haemorrhage protocol is called, the first red cells and plasma reach theatres within ten minutes.
